answer: Three options. (1) Upsert sink keyed by product and window start, so the replayed emission overwrites the earlier row and the latest wins. (2) Transactional sink that commits output in the same transaction as the offsets, so writes after the last checkpoint were never committed and replay does not duplicate them. (3) Dedupe view on read: ROW_NUMBER() over (product_id, window_start) ordered by emitted_at DESC, keeping rn = 1. Prefer the upsert when the sink supports it, because the dedupe view adds a window function to every query and leaves orphan rows in the table.
